description: This file defines a Python module for parsing C++ source code to identify interface classes inheriting from a specific base class and containing an 'ID' enum. It includes class definitions, a function to find interface classes, and references to an external CppParser module.

classes.name: Interface
classes.description: Represents a C++ interface class with attributes for object, ID, and source file.

methods.name: FindInterfaceClasses
methods.description: Recursively traverses a C++ parse tree to find classes that inherit from a specific base class and contain an 'ID' enum, returning a list of Interface instances.
